sugar-land-tx.name: City of Sugar Land, TX
sugar-land-tx.provider: Republic Services (City of Sugar Land Solid Waste and Recycling)

dropOffCenter.name: Fort Bend County Recycling Center
accepts: Electronics and e-waste (computers, monitors, TVs, cords)
Latex and oil-based paint, automotive fluids, household hazardous waste
Polystyrene (#6 foam) and rigid plastics not accepted curbside
Scrap metal and appliances without refrigerant

curbsideCartRules.glassNote: Clean glass bottles and jars (clear, brown, and green) are accepted in the Sugar Land single-stream recycling cart.
curbsideCartRules.bagNote: Never bag recyclables or place plastic bags or plastic grocery bags in the recycling cart. Film plastics tangle MRF star-screens; return clean dry bags to H-E-B or Kroger store drop-off bins.
curbsideCartRules.greasyPizzaBoxRule: Tear off the clean cardboard lid and recycle it; place the grease-soaked bottom half in the trash cart.
curbsideCartRules.greenWasteProgram: Set out yard trimmings, leaves, grass clippings, and brush on your scheduled green waste collection day in compostable paper lawn bags, reusable containers, or tied bundles under 4 feet and 40 pounds.

houston-tx.name: City of Houston, TX
houston-tx.provider: City of Houston Solid Waste Management Department (SWMD)

dropOffCenter.name: City of Houston Neighborhood Depository and Recycling Center / Westpark Consumer Recycling Center
dropOffCenter.location: 5900 Westpark Dr, Houston, TX 77057 (plus 6 Neighborhood Depositories)
accepts: Glass bottles and jars (always accepted at Neighborhood Depositories and Westpark)
Electronics, rechargeable batteries, and fluorescent bulbs (Environmental Service Centers)
BOPA items (Batteries, Oil, Paint, Antifreeze) at Westpark and North ESC
Scrap metal, bulk cardboard, and tree waste

curbsideCartRules.glassNote: Clean glass bottles and jars are accepted in Houston green Automated Recycling Carts (following FCC Environmental MRF upgrades), or at any Neighborhood Depository and Westpark Drop-Off. Broken glass, mirrors, and ceramics are strictly prohibited.
curbsideCartRules.bagNote: Plastic bags, wrap, and film are the #1 MRF tangler in Houston. Place items loose in the green cart; return film bags to retail grocery drop-off kiosks.
curbsideCartRules.greasyPizzaBoxRule: Detach clean cardboard tops for the green recycling cart; discard grease-saturated bottoms and food residue in the black garbage cart.
curbsideCartRules.greenWasteProgram: Yard trimmings must be placed in City-approved compostable biodegradable bags (with the city logo) or bundled under 4 feet and 50 pounds on designated tree/yard waste days.
